jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
The Chief of Staff (CoS) is a highly strategic, execution-focused, and operationally savvy leader who serves as a trusted partner to the CEO and executive team. This person acts as an integrator across functions, a right-hand to the CEO (but not a gatekeeper) and an internal accelerator to company-wide priorities. The Chief of Staff brings world-class organizational skills, executive-level judgment, and emotional intelligence to bear across a diverse and high-leverage portfolio of strategic, operational, and cross-functional responsibilities.

This role is ideal for a seasoned high-performing generalist who thrives in ambiguity, can think strategically for near and long-term, and brings structure for scale. This individual will spend two years in a Chief of Staff role and then, based on interest and capabilities, land in a high impact operating role within the company.



Please Note: This is a hybrid role, with three (3) in-office days in our Santa Clara, CA offices each week to foster collaboration and connection.



What You’ll Do

Strategic Planning & Execution - Partner with CEO to assess company progress vs. the annual plan - Coordinate and execute OKRs - Own quarterly business reviews (QBRs): define structure, metrics, and cadence - Responsible for the rhythm of the business, including task follow through, scheduling key meetings and preparing advance materials

New Initiative Design - Develop business cases and project plans for new initiatives - Develop proposals and transition plans for cross-functional initiatives

Program Execution & Project Management - Lead execution of high-leverage initiatives to the CEO - Serve as temporary owner for unstaffed experimental projects

Strategic Partnerships - Foster relationships throughout the company and most critically with the executive team -Create cross-functional alignment for effective collaboration and deliverables



What Success Looks Like

First Month - Onboard deeply into strategy and operations - Shadow key leaders; listen and observe CEO and E-team workflows

First 3 Months - Implement OKR + weekly E-team meeting cadence - Recommend and implement CEO playbook to improve operations and impact

First 6 Months - Lead execution of strategic initiatives - Own board prep, QBRs, other initiatives



What We’re Looking For

Core Competencies - Strategic Thinking - Execution & Rigor - Organizational Design & Ops - Emotional Intelligence - Communication & Influence - Cross-Functional Leadership - Confidentiality & Discretion

Attributes - Humble, curious, high ownership - Hyper responsive - Detail-oriented, structured - Calm under pressure - Sound judgment and strong anticipation of future workloads and dependencies

Experience - 6-8 years’ experience with strategy consulting and/or business operations experience a plus - Experience and comfort with executive level - Proven project leadership track record



Why Join LeanData:

 - LeanData covers up to 90% of employee insurance premiums

 - Stock options for all full-time employees

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401(k) plan

jobs.title: Head of People and Culture
jobs.description:
We are now at a pivotal transition with Katy Keim as our new CEO of LeanData. Katy is a seasoned C-Level people centric and strong strategic leader who is looking for a Head of  People and Culture to help us take the company to the next level. This People leader would partner with Katy and the E-Team to build a strong focus on talent and culture in order to help the business accelerate growth, expand into the enterprise, and reinvent the business with AI.



As a key part of leading the Talent strategy for LeanData, this role will partner closely with Katy to round out the seasoned executive team with a world class leader in Product and other key roles as the needs evolve. This individual will partner closely with the entire executive team to ensure the team continues to operate as a highly effective “One Team”.



Mission for the Role
Build and lead a high-performing, values-driven People function that scales with the company’s growth, fosters a healthy, inclusive culture, and empowers employees to do their best work and have fun while doing so.



Who We Are Searching For
A business and strategically minded People leader who has previous experience as a CPO or VP of HR in a high tech company in Silicon Valley. Exudes confidence, strong communication, and conviction about the importance of people and culture to positively impact the bottom line for the business. Strong capacity to support change management in the areas of LeanData’s transition such as:

○ AI reckoning

○ Commercial to Enterprise go to market motion

○ Engineering-led to Customer-led innovation

○ Directed execution to empowered decision-making



This person must have a passion for creating a culture of empowerment, and drive. One who can partner with the CEO and the leadership team as “One Team” to build the company of the future. This CPCO has a strong understanding and belief supporting the CEO’s team orientation and philosophy around building a team that is similar to that of a champion-level sports organization. Our corporate athletes are driven by shared goals, competitive edge, celebrating wins and learning from losses.



We are looking for a Talent partner who is:

● A progressive thinker not constrained by the bounds of traditional HR systems, processes, tools, approaches and who understands various ‘generations’ of the workforce. Who uses AI to help amplify and enhance the speed of the incredible work of the small and mighty HR team.

● A business-oriented leader accountable for establishing the People Vision and Talent Strategy for the company, and able to translate that strategy into aligned action across all the business functions. Can support and evolve for company growth for scale from $50M to $100M.

● A culture champion, indexing high on empathy and compassion, who can build upon, protect, and grow LeanData’s unique hybrid culture and bring the voice of the employees to strategic decision making discussions.



Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 12–18 Months)

 1. Strategic People Roadmap

○ Develop and execute a people strategy aligned with LeanData’s business goals.

○ Build a 12–18 month roadmap covering talent acquisition, employee experience, performance, change management, and organizational design.

○ Set the right tone and tenor for diversity and inclusion which maps to LeanData’s values and strengthens the culture through various perspectives, supporting and amplifying employee-led initiatives. 



 2. Leadership Development & Culture

○ Launch and embed a first ever leadership development program for first-line and mid-level managers.

○ Establish and reinforce a culture of feedback, accountability, and trust across all teams through a scalable programmatic approach beyond the existing performance management program.

○ Streamline and clarify decision-making frameworks agreed upon by E-Team to accelerate execution.

○ Inspire a learning culture to leverage AI to maximize employee potential.

○ Maintain and further cultivate a culture of belonging currently measured by the eNPS question, “I feel comfortable sharing opinions at work” (76% favorable, 19% neutral and 5% disagree).


 3. Hiring and Onboarding

○ Equip all managers with a consistent framework and philosophy to elevate their perspective on top talent in order to build a championship-caliber team.

○ Improve quality-of-hire metrics across key roles.

○ Design a high-impact onboarding experience with a 90%+ employee satisfaction rating.


 4. Performance & Compensation Systems

○ Lead the design, align with E-Team, and implement a transparent, competitive market and internally aligned compensation philosophy.

○ Continue to enhance our recently launched performance management framework, that supports accountability, consistency, as well as rewards, at all levels throughout the company.

○ Review our recent efforts on job leveling for the company to evaluate pay equity.

○ Listen, gather, and align with E-Team, then implement a fair, consistent and transparent promotion philosophy within LeanData that is in line with market practice.


 5. Employee Engagement & Retention

○ Achieve an employee engagement score of 80%+, building from baseline eNPS of 55, and efforts to engage high performers (rated 4 and 5) to reduce voluntary attrition.

○ Introduce action-oriented goals to support the eNPS bi-annual surveys and track follow-through on results.

○ Effectively foster connection and engagement among our smaller fully remote population, including a team in EMEA, ensuring they feel deeply integrated into LeanData’s culture and empowered to do their best work.



Competencies

● Strategic Thinking
Sees the big picture and anticipates future trends, including how AI and emerging technologies can become allies to talent strategy. Aligns the people initiatives tightly with business goals and growth phases. Respected by peers at the leadership table as a true voice of the employee and partner in shaping company direction.

● Exceptional Communication
Communicates clearly and compassionately across all levels — from Board members to new hires. Effectively facilitates difficult conversations and organizational messaging with empathy and confidence. Builds trust through transparency and consistency.

● Compassion & Emotional Intelligence
Balances business imperatives with genuine care for people. Creates a culture where people feel heard, respected, and supported. Trusted by employees across functions and levels as an accessible and fair partner.

● Execution & Bias for Action
Moves quickly and pragmatically, especially in resource-constrained environments. Applies the 80/20 rule to drive progress — aligning key stakeholders and iterating rather than waiting for perfect conditions. Tracks outcomes to learn and optimize as they go.

● Change Leadership
Leads through ambiguity with steadiness and vision. Builds alignment across the organization during periods of transformation, scale, or transition. Brings both clarity and compassion to change communication and execution.

● Data-Driven Insight & Analytical Rigor
Anchors decisions balanced in art & science (data) — grounded in feedback, recruiting funnel metrics, performance trends, engagement scores, attrition analyses, and external benchmarks. Uses data not just to measure what is happening, but to influence strategy, challenge assumptions, and elevate the People function as a business-critical driver. Comfortable presenting insights to the leadership team and Board in a compelling, actionable way.




EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS

● 10+ years in progressive HR or People leadership roles, including experience in a scaling tech company.

● Proven success leading People strategy at a company of 50–500 employees.

● Deep knowledge of HR Business Partnering, HR operations, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and DEI best practices.

● Experience working closely with executive teams and advising at the strategic level.

● Comfortable using HRIS, people analytics tools, and other systems to drive decisions.

jobs.title: Director, People Operations and Total Rewards
jobs.description:
Santa Clara, CA | Reports to the Head of People and Culture

LeanData helps the world’s fastest-growing companies automate, simplify, and accelerate revenue.

As our business evolves, we’re building the People infrastructure to support what comes next. We’re looking for a Director of People Operations and Total Rewards who can strengthen our foundation, simplify how work gets done, and build programs that help us attract, retain, and support exceptional talent in our championship culture.

You’ll own People Operations, compensation, and benefits, partnering closely with Finance, IT, and our People Business Partner. You’ll join a small, collaborative People team with the opportunity to shape the function, influence business decisions, and see the impact of your work directly. We share responsibility for the team’s success, support one another through competing priorities, and step in where we can make a difference.

Some of our systems and processes were built for an earlier stage. Your opportunity is to determine what to keep, what to improve, and what to reimagine, creating capacity through better systems, clear ownership, and thoughtful automation.

This is a hybrid role, with 3 days onsite (M/W/Th) in our Santa Clara office.




WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You’re a builder who enjoys turning complexity into something practical and easy to use. You can set a direction, make a recommendation, and get into the details to deliver it. You take pride in both the quality of your decisions and the reliability of everyday operations.

You understand that People Operations is part of how the business performs. You bring financial discipline and employee empathy to decisions, explain trade-offs clearly, and build trust through sound judgment and follow-through.

You’re curious about what’s possible with AI and automation, and are thoughtful about where human judgment matters. You challenge processes that no longer serve their purpose, learn quickly, and move improvements forward without waiting for perfect conditions.

You’re a strong teammate who listens before making changes, respects the expertise others bring, and builds solutions with the people who will use them. You share information openly, welcome feedback, and work through disagreements directly and respectfully. You’re comfortable leading an initiative, supporting someone else’s, and rolling up your sleeves when the team needs help.

Our values should feel familiar in how you work:

● Champion Customers: Understand the needs of the employees and leaders you support and make their experience better.

● Wonder Why: Ask questions, investigate root causes, and stay open to a better approach.

● Own It: Take accountability from identifying a problem through delivering a lasting solution.

● Build Bold: Test new approaches and turn ideas into measurable improvements.

● One Team: Work with low ego, share context, and build solutions across functions. Follow through on commitments, address challenges together, and put shared outcomes ahead of individual credit.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN


PEOPLE OPERATIONS AND SYSTEMS

● Set and execute the People Operations roadmap, prioritizing improvements based on business needs, employee experience, risk, and available resources.

● Own reliable operations across onboarding, offboarding, employee records, leaves, accommodations, policies, and employee changes.

● Partner with Finance on payroll, establishing clear responsibilities, accurate inputs, reconciliations, and timely resolution of issues.

● Improve our HR technology stack, integrations, workflows, documentation, and data quality. Use AI and automation to reduce manual work while protecting sensitive information and validating results.

● Establish service standards, controls, and escalation paths, and personally resolve complex operational issues.

● Partner with the People Business Partner on performance-cycle operations, organizational changes, and program rollouts, with clear ownership and coordinated employee communication. Build a close working partnership that connects operational improvements with what employees, managers, and the business need.

● Coordinate immigration matters with external counsel and internal stakeholders, ensuring dependable tracking, communication, and follow-through.




TOTAL REWARDS

● Develop and evolve our compensation and benefits strategy with the Head of People and Culture, People Business Partner, and Finance, balancing competitiveness, internal equity, affordability, and business priorities.

● Lead market benchmarking, job architecture, leveling, salary ranges, pay equity analysis, and compensation review cycles.

● Advise leaders on offers, promotions, incentives, and retention decisions, using market data and clear decision frameworks.

● Partner with Finance and Legal on equity program administration, approvals, and employee communications.

● Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and help managers communicate compensation decisions with confidence.




BENEFITS AND WELLBEING

● Own benefits strategy and delivery, including renewals, plan evaluation, cost modeling, open enrollment, and employee communications.

● Manage brokers, carriers, and vendors, holding partners accountable for service, accuracy, and value.

● Use employee feedback, utilization, and market insights to recommend improvements that balance employee needs with cost.

● Make benefits and leave programs understandable and accessible to employees.




COMPLIANCE, ANALYTICS, AND BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP

● Maintain compliant People practices across applicable employment requirements, with strong working knowledge of California and federal requirements and sound judgment about when to involve counsel.

● Own operational audit readiness, records management, access controls, and documentation; identify and address risks proactively.

● Partner with Finance, IT, Legal, and business leaders on workforce data, budgeting, systems, and operational priorities.

● Build useful reporting on workforce trends, compensation, benefits costs, and operational performance.

● Measure whether improvements reduce errors, save time, strengthen controls, and improve the employee experience.




WHAT YOU BRING

● 7+ years of progressive experience across People Operations, total rewards, or related HR disciplines, with accountability for a broad portfolio.

● A track record of building or improving People infrastructure in a lean, changing environment.

● Direct ownership of compensation programs, including benchmarking, salary structures, compensation cycles, and advising leaders on decisions.

● Experience owning benefits renewals, broker relationships, program costs, and enrollment.

● Strong HR systems and payroll process knowledge, including integrations, reporting, data quality, and controls.

● Practical experience managing employment compliance and sensitive operational issues.

● Financial and analytical confidence, including building cost models, evaluating market data, and making clear recommendations.

● Evidence of delivering measurable process improvements through technology, automation, or simpler ways of working.

● Strong communication, prioritization, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the willingness to stay hands-on.




EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE HELPFUL

● B2B SaaS or technology company experience.

● Experience supporting a primarily California-based workforce, with smaller teams in other locations, and coordinating immigration matters with external counsel.

● Experience with BambooHR, ADP Workforce Now, Lattice, Pave, Radford, or comparable platforms.

● Relevant HR, compensation, or benefits certifications.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Employees and managers experience accurate, responsive support. Our systems require less manual work, our data is dependable, and responsibilities across People and Finance are clear. Leaders have practical frameworks for compensation decisions, and the People team has more capacity to support the business as it evolves.
